title: Console: right after Add new view, the draft preview bar may read "no unpublished changes" while the new view's package-less draft is pending (measure first)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWTpQUNTBdBhmJtCzk

Filing gate: an out-of-scope observation of the #35600 dev, recorded on PR #35620 and its os-dev report (https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35600#issuecomment-7018093939) as "noted, not filed"; the seat directed it filed as a measure-first card. Area: build. Grade left to triage's first touch.

## What was seen (read once, not reproduced, timing not excluded)

During the #35600 browser journey (examples/app-crm, 2026-11-19, `origin/main` near `e25ca63e`), right after the console's 新建视图 / Add new view created a list view, the console's draft preview bar read:

> Draft preview — no unpublished changes; everything here is already live.

At the same moment `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts` listed the new view's draft (package-less: `packageId` null). The view's create goes through `createRuntimeMetadata` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`), which saves with `{ mode: 'draft' }` and no package and then calls `announceDraftLedgerWrite()` (objectui#13139), so the bar is expected to re-read and count the draft.

## Measure first

1. Reproduce: create a list view through the console's Add new view, and read the preview bar right after the create and after a short wait, with `_drafts` read alongside. Does the bar miss the draft every time, only briefly (a re-read race), or not at all?
2. If it misses: which reader the bar counts through (`usePendingDrafts`), and whether that reader drops a package-less draft (its scope / filter), or whether the refresh pulse fires before the write is readable.
3. If it does not reproduce, close this card with the reading.

## Expected

After a create that leaves a pending draft, the preview bar counts it (it offers Publish), as objectui#13139 set out for runtime saves.

Dedupe: issue search `draft preview no unpublished changes new view`, `preview bar no unpublished changes` → no open card on this; #35600 is the card it was seen under.
